user.title: LifeSmart
user.description: Choose how to talk to your LifeSmart devices.

data.mode: Mode (online = cloud API, offline = LAN station)

online.title: LifeSmart cloud (online)
online.description: Cloud OpenAPI credentials from the LifeSmart open platform.

offline.title: LifeSmart station (offline / LAN)
offline.description: Talk to the Smart Station directly over LAN. local_username/local_password are the station's local admin credentials (center management password). username/password are the cloud account and are only needed for fallback. IR remote list queries are only available in online mode.

data.fallback: Fall back to cloud when the station is unreachable

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect (station unreachable or cloud API error)
error.fallback_needs_cloud: Fallback requires AppKey/AppToken and the cloud account (username/password)
